reason: The diagnostic report shows exactly where my child is behind, and ₹299 is nothing compared to a tutor. I already use ChatGPT and YouTube with them, so a tool that targets the actual gaps is worth one month to see if it beats what I do now.
objection: More screen time is the last thing my child needs. If it turns into another app they tap through without learning, or it is no better than ChatGPT for free, I will cancel.
would_change_my_mind: If the weekly parent view shows no real improvement on the weak topics after the first month, or my relative's child says it is just busywork, I would cancel.
